scripts.build: pnpm build:naive && pnpm build:optimised && pnpm build:finegrained
scripts.build:optimised: BUILD_VARIANT=optimised vite build && mv dist/optimised/index.optimised.html dist/optimised/index.html
scripts.build:finegrained: BUILD_VARIANT=finegrained vite build && mv dist/finegrained/index.finegrained.html dist/finegrained/index.html
